SCRIPT_PATH.description: Path to the directory containing SystemTap scripts.

CONFIG_PATH.description: Path to the directory containing SystemTap configuration files.

CACHE_PATH.description: Path to the SystemTap cache directory.

STAT_PATH.description: Path to the SystemTap runtime state directory.

LOG_FILE.description: Path to the SystemTap log file.

PASSALL.description: Fail if any script fails to run successfully.

AUTOCOMPILE.description: Automatically recompile scripts if caches are old or missing.

DEFAULT_START.description: List of scripts to start by default. If omitted, all scripts are started.

LOG_BOOT_ERR.description: Log boot-time staprun stderr to the script's log file.
